euclidean_cluster — 3D segment op

• Data kinds: points → labels

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.euclidean_cluster(points, tol: 'float', min_size: 'int' = 10) -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import segment3d; segment3d.euclidean_cluster(points, tol: 'float', min_size: 'int' = 10) -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, ops3d.get("euclidean_cluster"))

Usage

Distance clustering by the connected components of the proximity graph at radius tol (−1 = noise).

Groups points that are within tol of each other (transitively) into the same cluster. Spatially separated objects become separate clusters (used to separate "which blob is a graspable object" after ground-plane removal). Connected components smaller than min_size are noise, -1. Labels are 0,1,2,... in descending order of cluster size (deterministic).

Args:

points: (N,3) point cloud.

tol: proximity radius for being considered the same cluster (a distance, must be > 0).

min_size: connected components smaller than this are noise (-1).

Returns:

labels: (N,) int. 0..(n_clusters-1) are clusters, -1 is noise. Empty input gives shape (0,).
